notes.title: New Uncensored Release - Yuri Visual Novel, Forest Guardian!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12668505/98ca23738fb545bc6ba53290456631cb03427e99.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

This is a quick update, just dropping in to let everyone know we've rolled out a new release, a fantasy yuri visual novel entitled "Forest Guardian". It's [b]completely uncensored[/b] and features around 5~ hours of gameplay and around 20 CGs. It also features foxgirls! It runs at $10.99, but will have a 10% discount for the next week.

Pick it up here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1181030/Forest_Guardian

notes.title: Approved For Release! - Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We again apologize for the silence regarding the release date of the game. The game has been sitting in Valve's compliance for quite awhile, but we are happy to say it has passed their build review stage and will be launching very soon. While we originally wanted to launch this week, we realize that we're a bit frighteningly close to the holidays, and we don't want to be overshadowed by the festivities and such. As such, we have a concrete release date, January 3rd, 2020, right after the holiday season passes. We will be launching the game, as well as a deluxe edition, which includes extra goodies like the OST & Artbook. 

For backers of the game on Kickstarter, don't worry! We will be sending out early DRM-Free copies starting Friday. We will provide steam keys once the game is released on the platform however. We will also be updating screenshots for everyone to see how far the game has progressed since the page originally went live. Thank you for your time everyone, and we hope you will enjoy the upcoming release!

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Sorry for the delay these past few days; we apologize for going over the previous release date, which was supposed to be earlier in the month. Unfortunately, we need just a bit more time. At the moment the game is almost done, but is currently in QA. We are also waiting for the artbook to be finished, so it can launch alongside the game. These are the last two things, and we're working very hard behind the scenes to try and have them ready soon. We apologize for the delay and hope you will enjoy the upcoming game!
